versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־תַעֲשׂ֨וּ לָכֶ֜ם אֱלִילִ֗ם וּפֶ֤סֶל וּמַצֵּבָה֙ לֹֽא־תָקִ֣ימוּ לָכֶ֔ם וְאֶ֣בֶן מַשְׂכִּ֗ית לֹ֤א תִתְּנוּ֙ בְּאַרְצְכֶ֔ם לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֖ת עָלֶ֑יהָ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: “‘You shall make for yourselves no idols, neither shall you raise up an engraved image or a pillar, neither shall you place any figured stone in your land, to bow down to it; for I am Yahweh your God.
controles.kjv: Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up any image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am the Lord your God.
controles.livre: Não fareis para vós ídolos, nem escultura, nem levantareis para vós estátua, nem poreis em vossa terra pedra pintada para inclinar-vos a ela: porque eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.

versos.hebraico: אֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתַ֣י תִּשְׁמֹ֔רוּ וּמִקְדָּשִׁ֖י תִּירָ֑אוּ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃ס

controles.web: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the Lord.
controles.livre: Guardai meus sábados, e tende em reverência meu santuário: Eu sou o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: אִם־בְּחֻקֹּתַ֖י תֵּלֵ֑כוּ וְאֶת־מִצְוֺתַ֣י תִּשְׁמְר֔וּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: “‘If you walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;
controles.kjv: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;
controles.livre: Se andardes em meus decretos, e guardardes meus mandamentos, e os puserdes por obra;

versos.hebraico: וְנָתַתִּ֥י גִשְׁמֵיכֶ֖ם בְּעִתָּ֑ם וְנָתְנָ֤ה הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ יְבוּלָ֔הּ וְעֵ֥ץ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה יִתֵּ֥ן פִּרְיֽוֹ׃

controles.web: then I will give you your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
controles.kjv: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
controles.livre: Eu darei vossa chuva em seu tempo, e a terra produzirá, e a árvore do campo dará seu fruto;

versos.hebraico: וְהִשִּׂ֨יג לָכֶ֥ם דַּ֨יִשׁ֙ אֶת־בָּצִ֔יר וּבָצִ֖יר יַשִּׂ֣יג אֶת־זָ֑רַע וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם לַחְמְכֶם֙ לָשֹׂ֔בַע וִֽישַׁבְתֶּ֥ם לָבֶ֖טַח בְּאַרְצְכֶֽם׃

controles.web: Your threshing shall reach to the vintage, and the vintage shall reach to the sowing time. You shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
controles.kjv: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
controles.livre: E a debulha vos alcançará à vindima, e a vindima alcançará à sementeira, e comereis vosso pão em fartura e habitareis seguros em vossa terra:

versos.hebraico: וְנָתַתִּ֤י שָׁלוֹם֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וּשְׁכַבְתֶּ֖ם וְאֵ֣ין מַחֲרִ֑יד וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֞י חַיָּ֤ה רָעָה֙ מִן־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְחֶ֖רֶב לֹא־תַעֲבֹ֥ר בְּאַרְצְכֶֽם׃

controles.web: “‘I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and no one will make you afraid. I will remove evil animals out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
controles.kjv: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
controles.livre: E eu darei paz na terra, e dormireis, e não haverá quem vos espante: e farei tirar os animais ferozes de vossa terra, e não passará por vosso país a espada:

versos.hebraico: וּרְדַפְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־אֹיְבֵיכֶ֑ם וְנָפְל֥וּ לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם לֶחָֽרֶב

controles.web: You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
controles.kjv: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
controles.livre: E perseguireis a vossos inimigos, e cairão à espada diante de vós:

versos.hebraico: וְרָדְפ֨וּ מִכֶּ֤ם חֲמִשָּׁה֙ מֵאָ֔ה וּמֵאָ֥ה מִכֶּ֖ם רְבָבָ֣ה יִרְדֹּ֑פוּ וְנָפְל֧וּ אֹיְבֵיכֶ֛ם לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם לֶחָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
controles.kjv: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
controles.livre: E cinco de vós perseguirão a cem, e cem de vós perseguirão a dez mil, e vossos inimigos cairão à espada diante de vós.

versos.hebraico: וּפָנִ֣יתִי אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְהִפְרֵיתִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֖י אֶתְכֶ֑ם וַהֲקִימֹתִ֥י אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֖י אִתְּכֶֽם׃

controles.web: “‘I will have respect for you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.
controles.kjv: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.
controles.livre: Porque eu me voltarei a vós, e vos farei crescer, e vos multiplicarei, e afirmarei meu pacto convosco:

versos.hebraico: וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֥ם יָשָׁ֖ן נוֹשָׁ֑ן וְיָשָׁ֕ן מִפְּנֵ֥י חָדָ֖שׁ תּוֹצִֽיאוּ׃

controles.web: You shall eat old store long kept, and you shall move out the old because of the new.
controles.kjv: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.
controles.livre: E comereis o antigo de muito tempo, e tirareis fora o antigo por causa do novo:

versos.hebraico: וְנָתַתִּ֥י מִשְׁכָּנִ֖י בְּתוֹכְכֶ֑ם וְלֹֽא־תִגְעַ֥ל נַפְשִׁ֖י אֶתְכֶֽם׃

controles.web: I will set my tent among you, and my soul won’t abhor you.
controles.kjv: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.
controles.livre: E porei minha morada em meio de vós, e minha alma não vos abominará:

versos.hebraico: וְהִתְהַלַּכְתִּי֙ בְּת֣וֹכְכֶ֔ם וְהָיִ֥יתִי לָכֶ֖ם לֵֽאלֹהִ֑ים וְאַתֶּ֖ם תִּהְיוּ־לִ֥י לְעָֽם׃

controles.web: I will walk among you, and will be your God, and you will be my people.
controles.kjv: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.
controles.livre: E andarei entre vós, e eu serei vosso Deus, e vós sereis meu povo.

versos.hebraico: אֲנִ֞י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֤אתִי אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם מִֽהְיֹ֥ת לָהֶ֖ם עֲבָדִ֑ים וָאֶשְׁבֹּר֙ מֹטֹ֣ת עֻלְּכֶ֔ם וָאוֹלֵ֥ךְ אֶתְכֶ֖ם קֽוֹמְמִיּֽוּת׃פ

controles.web: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their slaves. I have broken the bars of your yoke, and made you go upright.
controles.kjv: I am the Lord your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.
controles.livre: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus, que vos tirei da terra do Egito, para que não fôsseis seus servos; e rompi as barras de vosso jugo, e vos fiz andar com o rosto alto.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־לֹ֥א תִשְׁמְע֖וּ לִ֑י וְלֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ אֵ֥ת כָּל־הַמִּצְוֺ֖ת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

controles.web: “‘But if you will not listen to me, and will not do all these commandments;
controles.kjv: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;
controles.livre: Porém se não me ouvirdes, nem fizerdes todos estes meus mandamentos,

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־בְּחֻקֹּתַ֣י תִּמְאָ֔סוּ וְאִ֥ם אֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַ֖י תִּגְעַ֣ל נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם לְבִלְתִּ֤י עֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֺתַ֔י לְהַפְרְכֶ֖ם אֶת־בְּרִיתִֽי׃

controles.web: and if you shall reject my statutes, and if your soul abhors my ordinances, so that you will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant;
controles.kjv: And if ye shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that ye will not do all my commandments, but that ye break my covenant:
controles.livre: E se abominardes meus decretos, e vossa alma menosprezar meus regulamentos, não executando todos meus mandamentos, e invalidando meu pacto;

versos.hebraico: אַף־אֲנִ֞י אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־זֹּ֣את לָכֶ֗ם וְהִפְקַדְתִּ֨י עֲלֵיכֶ֤ם בֶּֽהָלָה֙ אֶת־הַשַּׁחֶ֣פֶת וְאֶת־הַקַּדַּ֔חַת מְכַלּ֥וֹת עֵינַ֖יִם וּמְדִיבֹ֣ת נָ֑פֶשׁ וּזְרַעְתֶּ֤ם לָרִיק֙ זַרְעֲכֶ֔ם וַאֲכָלֻ֖הוּ אֹיְבֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: I also will do this to you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away. You will sow your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it.
controles.kjv: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.
controles.livre: Eu também farei convosco isto: enviarei sobre vós terror, enfermidade e febre, que consumam os olhos e atormentem a alma: e semeareis em vão vossa semente, porque vossos inimigos a comerão:

versos.hebraico: וְנָתַתִּ֤י פָנַי֙ בָּכֶ֔ם וְנִגַּפְתֶּ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י אֹיְבֵיכֶ֑ם וְרָד֤וּ בָכֶם֙ שֹֽׂנְאֵיכֶ֔ם וְנַסְתֶּ֖ם וְאֵין־רֹדֵ֥ף אֶתְכֶֽם׃ס

controles.web: I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and you will flee when no one pursues you.
controles.kjv: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.
controles.livre: E porei minha ira sobre vós, e sereis feridos diante de vossos inimigos; e os que vos aborrecem vos dominarão, e fugireis sem que haja quem vos persiga.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֨ם־עַד־אֵ֔לֶּה לֹ֥א תִשְׁמְע֖וּ לִ֑י וְיָסַפְתִּי֙ לְיַסְּרָ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם שֶׁ֖בַע עַל־חַטֹּאתֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: “‘If you in spite of these things will not listen to me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.
controles.kjv: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.
controles.livre: E se ainda com estas coisas não me ouvirdes, eu voltarei a castigar-vos sete vezes mais por vossos pecados.

versos.hebraico: וְשָׁבַרְתִּ֖י אֶת־גְּא֣וֹן עֻזְּכֶ֑ם וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־שְׁמֵיכֶם֙ כַּבַּרְזֶ֔ל וְאֶֽת־אַרְצְכֶ֖ם כַּנְּחֻשָֽׁה׃

controles.web: I will break the pride of your power, and I will make your sky like iron, and your soil like brass.
controles.kjv: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:
controles.livre: E quebrarei a soberba de vossa força, e voltarei vosso céu como ferro, e vossa terra como bronze:

versos.hebraico: וְתַ֥ם לָרִ֖יק כֹּחֲכֶ֑ם וְלֹֽא־תִתֵּ֤ן אַרְצְכֶם֙ אֶת־יְבוּלָ֔הּ וְעֵ֣ץ הָאָ֔רֶץ לֹ֥א יִתֵּ֖ן פִּרְיֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Your strength will be spent in vain; for your land won’t yield its increase, neither will the trees of the land yield their fruit.
controles.kjv: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.
controles.livre: E vossa força se consumirá em vão; que vossa terra não dará seu produto, e as árvores da terra não darão seu fruto.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־תֵּֽלְכ֤וּ עִמִּי֙ קֶ֔רִי וְלֹ֥א תֹאב֖וּ לִשְׁמֹ֣עַֽ לִ֑י וְיָסַפְתִּ֤י עֲלֵיכֶם֙ מַכָּ֔ה שֶׁ֖בַע כְּחַטֹּאתֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: “‘If you walk contrary to me, and won’t listen to me, then I will bring seven times more plagues on you according to your sins.
controles.kjv: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.
controles.livre: E se andardes comigo em oposição, e não me quiserdes ouvir, eu acrescentarei sobre vós sete vezes mais pragas segundo vossos pecados.

versos.hebraico: וְהִשְׁלַחְתִּ֨י בָכֶ֜ם אֶת־חַיַּ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ וְשִׁכְּלָ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְהִכְרִ֨יתָה֙ אֶת־בְּהֶמְתְּכֶ֔ם וְהִמְעִ֖יטָה אֶתְכֶ֑ם וְנָשַׁ֖מּוּ דַּרְכֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: I will send the wild animals among you, which will rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and make you few in number. Your roads will become desolate.
controles.kjv: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your high ways shall be desolate.
controles.livre: Enviarei também contra vós animais feras que vos arrebatem os filhos, e destruam vossos animais, e vos reduzam a poucos, e vossos caminhos sejam desertos.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֨ם־בְּאֵ֔לֶּה לֹ֥א תִוָּסְר֖וּ לִ֑י וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֥ם עִמִּ֖י קֶֽרִי׃

controles.web: “‘If by these things you won’t be reformed to me, but will walk contrary to me;
controles.kjv: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;
controles.livre: E se com estas coisas não fordes corrigidos, mas que andardes comigo em oposição,

versos.hebraico: וְהָלַכְתִּ֧י אַף־אֲנִ֛י עִמָּכֶ֖ם בְּקֶ֑רִי וְהִכֵּיתִ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ גַּם־אָ֔נִי שֶׁ֖בַע עַל־חַטֹּאתֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: then I will also walk contrary to you; and I will strike you, even I, seven times for your sins.
controles.kjv: Then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.
controles.livre: Eu também procederei convosco, em oposição e vos ferirei ainda sete vezes por vossos pecados:

versos.hebraico: וְהֵבֵאתִ֨י עֲלֵיכֶ֜ם חֶ֗רֶב נֹקֶ֨מֶת֙ נְקַם־בְּרִ֔ית וְנֶאֱסַפְתֶּ֖ם אֶל־עָרֵיכֶ֑ם וְשִׁלַּ֤חְתִּי דֶ֨בֶר֙ בְּת֣וֹכְכֶ֔ם וְנִתַּתֶּ֖ם בְּיַד־אוֹיֵֽב׃

controles.web: I will bring a sword upon you that will execute the vengeance of the covenant. You will be gathered together within your cities, and I will send the pestilence among you. You will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
controles.kjv: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant: and when ye are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
controles.livre: E trarei sobre vós espada vingadora, em castigo do pacto; e vos recolhereis a vossas cidades; mas eu enviarei pestilência entre vós, e sereis entregues em mão do inimigo.

versos.hebraico: בְּשִׁבְרִ֣י לָכֶם֮ מַטֵּה־לֶחֶם֒ וְ֠אָפוּ עֶ֣שֶׂר נָשִׁ֤ים לַחְמְכֶם֙ בְּתַנּ֣וּר אֶחָ֔ד וְהֵשִׁ֥יבוּ לַחְמְכֶ֖ם בַּמִּשְׁקָ֑ל וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֖ם וְלֹ֥א תִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃ס

controles.web: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight. You shall eat, and not be satisfied.
controles.kjv: And when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver you your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.
controles.livre: Quando eu vos quebrantar o sustento de pão, cozerão dez mulheres vosso pão em um forno, e vos devolverão vosso pão por peso; e comereis, e não vos fartareis.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֨ם־בְּזֹ֔את לֹ֥א תִשְׁמְע֖וּ לִ֑י וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֥ם עִמִּ֖י בְּקֶֽרִי׃

controles.web: “‘If you in spite of this won’t listen to me, but walk contrary to me;
controles.kjv: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;
controles.livre: E se com isto não me ouvirdes, mas procederdes comigo em oposição,

versos.hebraico: וְהָלַכְתִּ֥י עִמָּכֶ֖ם בַּחֲמַת־קֶ֑רִי וְיִסַּרְתִּ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ אַף־אָ֔נִי שֶׁ֖בַע עַל־חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם׃

controles.web: then I will walk contrary to you in wrath. I will also chastise you seven times for your sins.
controles.kjv: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.
controles.livre: Eu procederei convosco em contra e com ira, e vos castigarei ainda sete vezes por vossos pecados.

versos.hebraico: וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֖ם בְּשַׂ֣ר בְּנֵיכֶ֑ם וּבְשַׂ֥ר בְּנֹתֵיכֶ֖ם תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃

controles.web: You will eat the flesh of your sons, and you will eat the flesh of your daughters.
controles.kjv: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.
controles.livre: E comereis as carnes de vossos filhos, e comereis as carnes de vossas filhas:

versos.hebraico: וְהִשְׁמַדְתִּ֞י אֶת־בָּמֹֽתֵיכֶ֗ם וְהִכְרַתִּי֙ אֶת־חַמָּ֣נֵיכֶ֔ם וְנָֽתַתִּי֙ אֶת־פִּגְרֵיכֶ֔ם עַל־פִּגְרֵ֖י גִּלּוּלֵיכֶ֑ם וְגָעֲלָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖י אֶתְכֶֽם׃

controles.web: I will destroy your high places, and cut down your incense altars, and cast your dead bodies upon the bodies of your idols; and my soul will abhor you.
controles.kjv: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.
controles.livre: E destruirei vossos altos, e exterminarei vossas imagens, e porei vossos corpos mortos sobre os corpos mortos de vossos ídolos, e meu alma vos abominará:

versos.hebraico: וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־עָֽרֵיכֶם֙ חָרְבָּ֔ה וַהֲשִׁמּוֹתִ֖י אֶת־מִקְדְּשֵׁיכֶ֑ם וְלֹ֣א אָרִ֔יחַ בְּרֵ֖יחַ נִיחֹֽחֲכֶֽם׃

controles.web: I will lay your cities waste, and will bring your sanctuaries to desolation. I will not take delight in the sweet fragrance of your offerings.
controles.kjv: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.
controles.livre: E porei vossas cidades em deserto, e assolarei vossos santuários, e não cheirarei a fragrância de vosso suave incenso.

versos.hebraico: וַהֲשִׁמֹּתִ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְשָֽׁמְמ֤וּ עָלֶ֨יהָ֙ אֹֽיְבֵיכֶ֔ם הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: I will bring the land into desolation; and your enemies that dwell therein will be astonished at it.
controles.kjv: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.
controles.livre: Eu assolarei também a terra, e se pasmarão dela vossos inimigos que nela moram:

versos.hebraico: וְאֶתְכֶם֙ אֱזָרֶ֣ה בַגּוֹיִ֔ם וַהֲרִיקֹתִ֥י אַחֲרֵיכֶ֖ם חָ֑רֶב וְהָיְתָ֤ה אַרְצְכֶם֙ שְׁמָמָ֔ה וְעָרֵיכֶ֖ם יִהְי֥וּ חָרְבָּֽה׃

controles.web: I will scatter you among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you. Your land will be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.
controles.kjv: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.
controles.livre: E a vós vos espalharei pelas nações, e desembainharei espada atrás de vós: e vossa terra estará assolada, e desertas vossas cidades.

versos.hebraico: אָז֩ תִּרְצֶ֨ה הָאָ֜רֶץ אֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתֶ֗יהָ כֹּ֚ל יְמֵ֣י הֳשַׁמָּ֔ה וְאַתֶּ֖ם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֹיְבֵיכֶ֑ם אָ֚ז תִּשְׁבַּ֣ת הָאָ֔רֶץ וְהִרְצָ֖ת אֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: Then the land will enjoy its Sabbaths as long as it lies desolate and you are in your enemies’ land. Even then the land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.
controles.kjv: Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye be in your enemies’ land; even then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.
controles.livre: Então a terra folgará seus sábados todos os dias que estiver assolada, e vós na terra de vossos inimigos: a terra descansará então e desfrutará seus sábados.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־יְמֵ֥י הָשַּׁמָּ֖ה תִּשְׁבֹּ֑ת אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־שָׁבְתָ֛ה בְּשַׁבְּתֹתֵיכֶ֖ם בְּשִׁבְתְּכֶ֥ם עָלֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: As long as it lies desolate it shall have rest, even the rest which it didn’t have in your Sabbaths, when you lived on it.
controles.kjv: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.
controles.livre: Todo o tempo que estará assolada, folgará o que não folgou em vossos sábados enquanto habitáveis nela.

versos.hebraico: וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִ֣ים בָּכֶ֔ם וְהֵבֵ֤אתִי מֹ֨רֶךְ֙ בִּלְבָבָ֔ם בְּאַרְצֹ֖ת אֹיְבֵיהֶ֑ם וְרָדַ֣ף אֹתָ֗ם ק֚וֹל עָלֶ֣ה נִדָּ֔ף וְנָס֧וּ מְנֻֽסַת־חֶ֛רֶב וְנָפְל֖וּ וְאֵ֥ין רֹדֵֽף׃

controles.web: “‘As for those of you who are left, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. The sound of a driven leaf will put them to flight; and they shall flee, as one flees from the sword. They will fall when no one pursues.
controles.kjv: And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.
controles.livre: E aos que restarem de vós porei em seus corações tal covardia, na terra de seus inimigos, que o som de uma folha movida os perseguirá, e fugirão como de espada, e cairão sem que ninguém os persiga:

versos.hebraico: וְכָשְׁל֧וּ אִישׁ־בְּאָחִ֛יו כְּמִפְּנֵי־חֶ֖רֶב וְרֹדֵ֣ף אָ֑יִן וְלֹא־תִֽהְיֶ֤ה לָכֶם֙ תְּקוּמָ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י אֹֽיְבֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: They will stumble over one another, as it were before the sword, when no one pursues. You will have no power to stand before your enemies.
controles.kjv: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.
controles.livre: E tropeçarão uns nos outros, como se fugissem diante de espada, ainda que ninguém os persiga; e não podereis resistir diante de vossos inimigos.

versos.hebraico: וַאֲבַדְתֶּ֖ם בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם וְאָכְלָ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֶ֖רֶץ אֹיְבֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: You will perish among the nations. The land of your enemies will eat you up.
controles.kjv: And ye shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.
controles.livre: E perecereis entre as nações, e a terra de vossos inimigos vos consumirá.

versos.hebraico: וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִ֣ים בָּכֶ֗ם יִמַּ֨קּוּ֙ בַּֽעֲוֺנָ֔ם בְּאַרְצֹ֖ת אֹיְבֵיכֶ֑ם וְאַ֛ף בַּעֲוֺנֹ֥ת אֲבֹתָ֖ם אִתָּ֥ם יִמָּֽקּוּ׃

controles.web: Those of you who are left will pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers they shall pine away with them.
controles.kjv: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.
controles.livre: E os que restarem de vós perecerão nas terras de vossos inimigos por sua iniquidade; e pela iniquidade de seus pais perecerão com eles:

versos.hebraico: וְהִתְוַדּ֤וּ אֶת־עֲוֺנָם֙ וְאֶת־עֲוֺ֣ן אֲבֹתָ֔ם בְּמַעֲלָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָֽעֲלוּ־בִ֑י וְאַ֕ף אֲשֶׁר־הָֽלְכ֥וּ עִמִּ֖י בְּקֶֽרִי׃

controles.web: “‘If they confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against me, and also that, because they walked contrary to me,
controles.kjv: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;
controles.livre: E confessarão sua iniquidade, e a iniquidade de seus pais, por sua transgressão com que transgrediram contra mim: e também porque andaram comigo em oposição,

versos.hebraico: אַף־אֲנִ֗י אֵלֵ֤ךְ עִמָּם֙ בְּקֶ֔רִי וְהֵבֵאתִ֣י אֹתָ֔ם בְּאֶ֖רֶץ אֹיְבֵיהֶ֑ם אוֹ־אָ֣ז יִכָּנַ֗ע לְבָבָם֙ הֶֽעָרֵ֔ל וְאָ֖ז יִרְצ֥וּ אֶת־עֲוֺנָֽם׃

controles.web: I also walked contrary to them, and brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised heart is humbled, and they then accept the punishment of their iniquity;
controles.kjv: And that I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:
controles.livre: Eu também houver andado contrário a eles, e os houver metido na terra de seus inimigos: e então se humilhará seu coração incircunciso, e reconhecerão seu pecado;

versos.hebraico: וְזָכַרְתִּ֖י אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֣י יַעֲק֑וֹב וְאַף֩ אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֨י יִצְחָ֜ק וְאַ֨ף אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֧י אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֶזְכֹּ֖ר וְהָאָ֥רֶץ אֶזְכֹּֽר׃

controles.web: then I will remember my covenant with Jacob; and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham; and I will remember the land.
controles.kjv: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.
controles.livre: E eu me lembrarei de meu pacto com Jacó, e também de meu pacto com Isaque, e também de meu pacto com Abraão me lembrarei; e farei memória da terra.

versos.hebraico: וְהָאָרֶץ֩ תֵּעָזֵ֨ב מֵהֶ֜ם וְתִ֣רֶץ אֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתֶ֗יהָ בָּהְשַׁמָּה֙ מֵהֶ֔ם וְהֵ֖ם יִרְצ֣וּ אֶת־עֲוֺנָ֑ם יַ֣עַן וּבְיַ֔עַן בְּמִשְׁפָּטַ֣י מָאָ֔סוּ וְאֶת־חֻקֹּתַ֖י גָּעֲלָ֥ה נַפְשָֽׁם׃

controles.web: The land also will be left by them, and will enjoy its Sabbaths while it lies desolate without them: and they will accept the punishment of their iniquity; because, even because they rejected my ordinances, and their soul abhorred my statutes.
controles.kjv: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.
controles.livre: Que a terra estará desamparada deles, e folgará seus sábados, estando deserta por causa deles; mas entretanto se submeterão ao castigo de suas iniquidades: porquanto menosprezaram meus regulamentos, e teve a alma deles ódio de meus estatutos.

versos.hebraico: וְאַף־גַּם־זֹ֠את בִּֽהְיוֹתָ֞ם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֹֽיְבֵיהֶ֗ם לֹֽא־מְאַסְתִּ֤ים וְלֹֽא־גְעַלְתִּים֙ לְכַלֹּתָ֔ם לְהָפֵ֥ר בְּרִיתִ֖י אִתָּ֑ם כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them; for I am Yahweh their God;
controles.kjv: And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I am the Lord their God.
controles.livre: E ainda com tudo isto, estando eles em terra de seus inimigos, eu não os rejeitarei, nem os abominarei para consumi-los, invalidando meu pacto com eles: porque eu o SENHOR sou seu Deus:

versos.hebraico: וְזָכַרְתִּ֥י לָהֶ֖ם בְּרִ֣ית רִאשֹׁנִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוֹצֵֽאתִי־אֹתָם֩ מֵאֶ֨רֶץ מִצְרַ֜יִם לְעֵינֵ֣י הַגּוֹיִ֗ם לִהְיֹ֥ת לָהֶ֛ם לֵאלֹהִ֖ים אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: but I will for their sake remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am Yahweh.’”
controles.kjv: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their God: I am the Lord.
controles.livre: Antes me lembrarei deles pelo pacto antigo, quando os tirei da terra do Egito aos olhos das nações, para ser seu Deus: Eu sou o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֠לֶּה הַֽחֻקִּ֣ים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים֮ וְהַתּוֹרֹת֒ אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן יְהוָ֔ה בֵּינ֕וֹ וּבֵ֖ין בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּהַ֥ר סִינַ֖י בְּיַד־מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ

controles.web: These are the statutes, ordinances and laws, which Yahweh made between him and the children of Israel in Mount Sinai by Moses.
controles.kjv: These are the statutes and judgments and laws, which the Lord made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.
controles.livre: Estes são os decretos, regulamentos e leis que estabeleceu o SENHOR entre si e os filhos de Israel no monte Sinai por meio de Moisés.
